description: Earlier usual-domain experiments (SMP2020-EWECT general Weibo, test split, 5,000 rows). Fractions. Only the numbers are shipped; the final recipe does not use these models.

zero_shot_digit_labels.description: Qwen3.5-4B without fine-tuning; the prompt asks for a digit 0-5; one forward pass, softmax over the six digit tokens, thinking off.

zero_shot_word_labels.description: Qwen3.5-4B without fine-tuning; the same prompt and six answer words as the final models; one forward pass, thinking off.

native_thinking_zero_shot.description: Qwen3.5-4B without fine-tuning, native thinking mode (sampling with temperature 1.0, top-p 0.95, top-k 20, presence penalty 1.5; thinking budget 4,096 tokens with up to 3 attempts, the 100 rows still unresolved re-run with a budget of 8,192), digit answer (0-5) chosen greedily after thinking; BF16 weights served with llama.cpp.

digit_labels_lora_0p8b.description: Direct LoRA fine-tuning of Qwen3.5-0.8B with digit answers (0-5) instead of answer words; otherwise the A recipe (r 8, alpha 16, AdamW lr 2e-4, effective batch 16, up to 3 epochs, epoch chosen on dev Macro-F1), seed 42.

digit_labels_lora_2b.description: Direct LoRA fine-tuning of Qwen3.5-2B with digit answers (0-5) instead of answer words; otherwise the A recipe (r 8, alpha 16, AdamW lr 2e-4, effective batch 16, up to 3 epochs, epoch chosen on dev Macro-F1), seed 42.

digit_labels_lora_4b.description: Direct LoRA fine-tuning of Qwen3.5-4B with digit answers (0-5) instead of answer words; otherwise the A recipe (r 8, alpha 16, AdamW lr 2e-4, effective batch 16, up to 3 epochs, epoch chosen on dev Macro-F1), seed 42.

direct_lora_word_labels_4b.description: For comparison: the A recipe with answer words (A_s42 of this package).
